column1: # AQL Language Specification: generics angle-bracket sugar — Box<T>
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# `<` and `>` are GENERAL-PURPOSE parser tokens (D14): the generics
# angle rule is their only v1 consumer, gated on a CAPITALISED name
# immediately before the `<` (the type-name convention) — so a `<`
# anywhere else is a syntax error in v1 only because no other
# consumer exists yet, and comparisons stay on lt/gt. Desugaring
# happens at parse time in the conversion walks (D15): a def head
# `def Name<params>` emits the canonical `Name gen [params]`; every
# other position emits the paren span `( Name of [args] )`. No angle
# marker ever reaches the engine value stream — macros, quote, and
# Vm.parse see the canonical form. Commas between entries/args are
# optional separators, exactly like list elements.
# See design/GENERICS.10.md §6 + the Phase 6 landed-state note.
# §1  declarations — sugar/canonical twins
def Box<T> class {value:T} end Box
def Box gen [T] class {value:T} end Box
def Pair<K, V> refine Record [key:K value:V] end Pair of [String Integer]
def Pair<K V> refine Record [key:K value:V] end Pair of [String Integer]
def Sorted<T extends Number> refine Record [items:[:T]] end Sorted of [Integer]
def Sorted<T extends Number> refine Record [items:[:T]] end Sorted of [String]
def Result<T, E = Error> refine Record [ok:T err:E] end Result of [Integer]
def Mapper<T U> fnsig [[T] [U]] end (Mapper of [Integer String]) typeof
# §2  use sites — every position the canonical paren span works in
def Box<T> class {value:T} end Box<Integer> teq (Box of [Integer])
column3: a use-site is IDENTICAL to its canonical twin (one memoised node)

column1: def Box<T> class {value:T} def b:Box<Integer> {value:42} end b typeof
def Box<T> class {value:T} end (make Box<Integer> {value:42}) get value
def Box<T> class {value:T} end (make Box<Integer> {value:1}) is Box
column3: bare schema name admits any instantiation

column1: def Box<T> class {value:T} end (make Box<Integer> {value:1}) is Box<Integer>
def Box<T> class {value:T} end (make Box<Integer> {value:1}) is Box<Number>
column3: v1 invariance holds in sugar form too

column1: def Box<T> class {value:T} def Outer<T> refine Record [inner:Box<T> tag:String] end Outer of [Integer]

column1: def Box<T> class {value:T} def Pair<K, V> refine Record [key:K value:V] end (Box of [(Pair of [String Integer])]) teq Box<Pair<String, Integer>>
column3: nested sugar (no `>>` shift problem — `>` is a standalone token)

column1: def Box<T> class {value:T} def f fn [[x:Box<Integer>] [Integer] [x get value]] end f (make Box<Integer> {value:7})
def Box<T> class {value:T} def f fn [[x:Box<Integer>] [Integer] [x get value]] end f (make Box<String> {value:'s'})
def Box<T> class {value:T} def xs:[:Box<Integer>] [(make Box<Integer> {value:1})] end (xs get 0) get value
def Box<T> class {value:T} def xs:[:Box<Integer>] [(make Box<String> {value:'s'})]
def Box<T> class {value:T} def b (make Box<Integer> {value:7}) end case b [Box<Integer> 'int-box' 'other']
column3: a case clause matches the exact instantiation

column1: def Box<T> class {value:T} def b (make Box<String> {value:'s'}) end case b [Box<Integer> 'int-box' 'other']
# §3  canonical-stream visibility (D15) — macros and Vm.parse see parens
def Box<T> class {value:T} def m (macro [[e] [ quote [ unquote e ] ]]) end macroexpand (m Box<Integer>)
column3: a raw-capturing macro receives the canonical paren span, never an angle form
